title: Analyses of neurotoxicity following multiple metal exposures among adults living along the Yangtze River in Anhui Province, China: In vitro experiments with mild cognitive impairment integrating community population cohort.
authors: Bian, Chaoyi; Wang, Wanting; Yao, Zhiyuan; Wei, Wei; Chen, Jiapeng; Yang, Yang; Xu, Jiahua; Qiu, Guangwen; Qin, Qirong; Huang, Fen; Zhong, Qi
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨长江沿岸成人多种金属暴露与轻度认知障碍的关联，涉及分子对接但核心为流行病学与细胞实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the association between multiple metals exposure and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) among adults residing along the Yangtze River in Anhui Province, China. We integrated network toxicology, epidemiological cohort studies and in vitro experiments under human-realistic doses to elucidate the potential biological mechanisms of MCI induced by multiple metals exposure. Among the 1337 participants, cadmium (Cd) was positively associated with incident MCI (OR = 1.13, 95% CI: 1.01-1.26) and exhibited the strongest positive weight in the multiple-mixture models. Network toxicology analysis and molecular docking simulations evaluated the binding affinity of Cd to the targets related to cognitive function, and identified NFKB1 as the core key target. Cell experiments based on the actual Cd exposure concentrations of study population indicate that Cd can promote the activation of NF-kappaB in SH-SY5Y cells, and upregulate the expression of inflammatory factors. Population validation experiment showed that TNF-alpha and IL-6 partially mediated the association between Cd and MCI. Collectively, this study clarifies the potential biological mechanisms of MCI induced by multiple metals exposure, providing novel exposure biomarkers and therapeutic targets for the comprehensive prevention and treatment of MCI.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨中国安徽省长江沿岸成年居民多种金属暴露与轻度认知障碍（mild cognitive impairment, MCI）之间的关联。我们整合了网络毒理学、流行病学队列研究及人源现实剂量下的体外实验，以阐明多种金属暴露诱导MCI的潜在生物学机制。在1337名参与者中，镉（Cd）与MCI发病呈正相关（OR = 1.13, 95% CI: 1.01-1.26），并在多种混合物模型中表现出最强的正权重。网络毒理学分析和分子对接模拟评估了Cd与认知功能相关靶点的结合亲和力，并确定NFKB1为核心关键靶点。基于研究人群实际Cd暴露浓度的细胞实验表明，Cd可促进SH-SY5Y细胞中NF-kappaB的激活，并上调炎症因子的表达。人群验证实验显示，TNF-alpha和IL-6部分介导了Cd与MCI之间的关联。总体而言，本研究阐明了多种金属暴露诱导MCI的潜在生物学机制，为MCI的综合预防和治疗提供了新的暴露生物标志物和治疗靶点。
